name: HWA 6 hot-water boiler, free-flow tap, 230 V
region: International 230 V single phase 50/60 Hz article
note: Selected exact 230 V single-phase 2830 W article; no three-phase performance or electrical variant inferred. Overall dimensions include the supplied removable drip tray. Automatic water refill through new food-approved hose; potable inlet 0.1-1 MPa and manually operated supply tap. Device has no backflow preventer; site plumbing must meet applicable requirements. No fixed waste connection in complete connection/cleaning diagrams: removable drip tray and tap/bucket emptying, so drain=false. Level weight-bearing indoor countertop, 0 < ambient < 40 C; do not operate inside a cabinet or water-spray area. Leave ventilation space and front/rear service access; numeric clearance is not published. Accessible earthed socket; permanent connection if supplied without plug requires qualified installer, 30 mA earth-leakage protection and 3 mm contact separation. Fuse depends on cable/plug and local requirements, not an invented model rating. Manual free-flow dispense tap.
